title: Another Translator
text: On behalf of InnoTech Research, we'd like to welcome you back to the testing lab. We know that our last presentation of the X5 mind-reading device was not exactly successful. No, it was not. It was bad. Very bad. We are aware, but rest assured that all the glitches have been fixed, and at last we will be able to accurately read the thoughts of common household pets. Heard that before. Now, today's test subject is my own dog, Max. So, with your permission, let's begin. Yep. We have mind-linkers. Max, can you hear me? Woof, woof. Just kidding. It's me, Max. How are you feeling today? Great. Why is that, Max? Because Trump is getting impeached. Oh, that's better. Too bad it means he's gone. Gonna get re-elected for sure. Good job, dummies. What? No, Max. No, where did you hear that? On Fox News. Your parents let me watch when they babysit me. Oh, my God. Well, that's not true. There's a mountain of evidence against Trump. And name one conservative whose mind has been changed by any of it. Oh, right. You don't know any. I know conservatives. My cousin, Tina. Oh, right. Tina that you blocked on all social media. You're real close. All right. What is going on with that dog? Nothing. He's fine. Max, people have no reason to think that Trump is a good president. The economy. Unemployment. Stock market. Sorry, my kennel cough's acting up. Yikes. Burn. Max, Trump is a crook. No, dear. But he's playing a game the Democrats don't even know the rules to. And I hate to quote Charlie Sheen here, but... He's winning. Max, you're just a dog. You don't even know what you're talking about. You eat your own poop. And you ate a pizza crust out of the garbage last night. She thought she was being good by throwing it away. Ten minutes later, she's digging for it. We have no choice but to impeach. He's going to try to steal the next election. Like you stole my testicles? I'm still mad about that. Here's an actual experiment. Everyone say out loud the Democratic hopeful they're most excited about. I mean... Bloomberg! Yeah, terrific. Can't wait for November. Max, that's enough. You're just pretending you still like Trump because you're too embarrassed to admit how awful he is. Oh my god, is Rachel Maddow in the room? Please lecture me some more. It's working. Hey! Maddow is America's sweetheart, you dumb pug. Don't you worry that history will look back on this moment and we'll be embarrassed? If you want to talk embarrassing history, let's look at your web browser. Ooh. You're my best friend. I had no idea you felt like this. Well, you tend to do all the talking in the relationship. Well, no more Fox News, but I hear what you're saying. Shake and make up? Sure. Well, that concludes our presentation. So what did you think? Hated it. Funding revoked. Wait, no, please, wait. Let's just try the other test subject. Fire up the machine. Tulsi Gabbard 2020! What? Damn it!
